title: Dentistry

children.text: A five-year professional degree in dentistry taught in English, with practical clinical work forming a substantial part of the later years. Less oversubscribed than medicine while leading to a comparably clear professional path.

Teaching runs across two semesters a year. The language of instruction is set at programme level rather than faculty level, so it should be confirmed for this specific programme before an application is submitted.
A completed secondary certificate with denklik, and evidence of English for this English-taught programme, either an accepted external test result or a pass in the university's own proficiency exam.
Where the programme is competitive, subject grades are examined rather than the aggregate alone.

careerOutcomes: Graduates practise as dentists subject to local licensing. The degree is also a route into oral surgery and orthodontic specialisation through further study.
documentsRequired: Passport, valid for the full duration of study where possible
